correctness.rationale: For n=2m≥4 the directed rim-only complex is ∂Δ(E)=S^{n-2}; at most one inward and one outward spoke. Each one-spoke simplex cones over a rim facet and collapses relative to rim. Two-spoke links exclude appropriate degree-conflict arcs and the forward hub cycle. Precisely m adjacent (i,i+1) spoke pairs have spherical link ∂Δ(n-1 arcs) and introduce (n−1)-balls with attaching S^{n−2}, while all nonadjacent links are cones and contribute homotopy-equivalent attachments. The explicit simplicial map fixing rim arcs and sending all spokes to odd e1 retracts X onto rim, so all higher attaching maps become null in A≃S^{n-2}. Finite exhaustive independent arc-graph enumeration for n=4,6,8,10 yielded 64,413,2386,12967 nonempty faces and χ=0,-1,-2,-3 respectively. This supports definitions; uniform homotopy follows from combinatorial topology rather than extrapolation.
